abstract: This study investigates the impact of generative AI assistance on worker productivity in customer service roles. The research finds that AI assistance increases average productivity by 15%, with particularly pronounced gains for less experienced workers, suggesting that AI helps disseminate best practices from top performers across the workforce.
keyFindings: Generative AI assistance increases customer service worker productivity by 15% on average
Less experienced workers experience the most significant productivity improvements from AI assistance
AI disseminates best practices from top performers to other workers
